interrupted:
# Work interrupted

Your previous work period was interrupted.
owner_stop:
# Work interrupted

Your previous work period was stopped by the owner.
lost: Previous working memory is unavailable. Your files and mail remain.
check_results: Some actions may already have completed; check durable results before repeating actions.
recent_claims: Recently claimed mail (claiming does not prove completion or unfinished work):
handoff:
# Continuing your work

You are starting with fresh working memory. Your saved notes follow:
<handoff-notes>
${notes}
</handoff-notes>
fresh:
# Continuing your work

You are starting with fresh working memory. Your files and mail remain. Inspect saved work before continuing; no handoff notes were saved for this work period.
default: Continue the work available to you.
mandate_changed: Your manager revised your responsibility. The current mandate in your standing instructions replaces the earlier mandate.
temporary: You have ${remaining} work periods remaining, including this one. Your manager can renew or make your role permanent. This work period may finish normally.
message: Mail arrived since your previous work period began; it may already be read.
owner_fresh_route: The owner reopened your work with fresh working memory.
renew_temporary: Your manager renewed your allocated work periods.
promote: Your manager made your appointment permanent.
authorized_retry: Your manager or owner authorized another attempt.
dependency_recovery: Operations is retrying work after a shared service interruption.
